label: fs-w39-mlp-forward-remote-ingest-r1
purpose: Recover the interrupted local profile analysis on the idle 124 GiB host, retaining raw captures and using a unique ingestion output. CPU-only analysis still holds the host experiment lock and receives automatic pre/post cleanup.
command:
import pathlib,os,hashlib,subprocess,json,time
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
source=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/trainium_freshstart_20260918_wave36/out/fs-w36-dense1024-fused-mlp-forward-device-r1')
stage=root/'out/fs-w39-mlp-forward-ingest-input-r1'
output=root/'out/fs-w39-mlp-forward-parquet-r1'
assert source.is_dir() and not stage.exists() and not output.exists()
stage.mkdir(parents=True)
for p in source.rglob('*'):
 if p.is_file():
  target=stage/p.relative_to(source);target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);os.link(p,target)
neffs=list(stage.rglob('*.neff'))
for trace in list(stage.rglob('*.ntff')):
 for neff in neffs:
  target=trace.parent/neff.name
  if not target.exists():os.link(neff,target)
  elif target.stat().st_ino!=neff.stat().st_ino:
   assert hashlib.file_digest(target.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()==hashlib.file_digest(neff.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()
command=['/home/ubuntu/workspace/native_venv/bin/neuron-explorer','view','--session-dir',str(stage),'--ingest-only','--output-format','parquet','--output-file',str(output)]
print('INGEST_START '+json.dumps({'source':str(source),'stage':str(stage),'output':str(output),'command':command,'raw_preserved':True}),flush=True)
start=time.monotonic();completed=subprocess.run(command,cwd=stage)
print('INGEST_COMPLETE '+json.dumps({'returncode':completed.returncode,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'tables':len(list(output.rglob('*.parquet'))),'instruction_files':[(str(p),p.stat().st_size) for p in output.rglob('Instruction.parquet')]}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(completed.returncode)
